Kangana Ranaut's 'Gutter-born' Remark Sparks Controversy, Ashutosh Rana Responds

Actress Kangana Ranaut's use of the term 'gutter-born generation' has ignited controversy. Actor Ashutosh Rana responded to the remark, stating that a person's identity is shaped by their language and emphasizing the importance of using words thoughtfully. Rana suggested that words can lead to both great achievements and severe consequences.
